recap:

The press structure aligned with the game plan target of a PPDA $\le 8.0$, achieving a 7.8 figure. Defensive line height remained compliant at 38.6 m, while possession width hit the target of 48.0 m. However, the counter-press regains fell short of the 24% target, registering only 21%.

The match was defined by high-impact moments. BHA’s first goal arrived via a high regain, with #9 Harvey Radley scoring (xG 0.26, 86 km/h) assisted by #10 Niko Iwobi-Lane at minute 19. LIV’s goal came on the counter, demonstrating potent transitional play, with #9 Caleb Ekwueme scoring (xG 0.35, 99 km/h) assisted by #11 Rafael Marchetti at minute 41.

The game plan successfully converted set-piece opportunities, with first contact won at 63% and defending set pieces at 92%. A critical moment was BHA’s second goal; #5 Isaac Kane-Moss scored from a set piece (xG 0.37, 52 km/h), assisted by #7 Tomas Calloway at minute 63. Running metrics showed a total distance of 116.0 km, with #4 Jai Varga running 10.2% less than his first 30', illustrating controlled exertion. (Demo data.)
